gesture.kind: Two-touch twist, not pinch zoom or physical drive
gesture.pointerTypes: Two touch contacts on same input surface; mixed/outside/third contact cancels
gesture.response: Direct gesture angle, no inertia; RAF coalesces visual updates
gesture.release: Pose retained; remaining contact drains until up, no fallback to translation
gesture.mode: Entering twist cancels previous target and latches local preview until closing/reopening
gesture.previousPhysicalTargetRelease: Existing release callback only if a real target had been sent
gesture.translationAfterTurn: Screen-relative, inverse heading rotation to body wheel speeds
gesture.wheelPivotOffsets: FL/RL=-theta*L/R; FR/RR=+theta*L/R, applied as deltas to preserve phase
gesture.reducedMotion: Direct pose remains functional; secondary wheel/chevron animation suppressed
